featured_reviews.name: Suryaprakash Barnwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the privilege of visiting Sri Guru Nanak Darbar in Mira Road East on the occasion of Baisakhi, and it was truly a soul-stirring experience. The entire gurdwara was beautifully decorated, creating a warm and festive atmosphere that instantly lifted my spirits.

From the moment I stepped in, there was a sense of peace and spiritual calm. The kirtan was deeply moving, and the energy of the sangat coming together in celebration of such a significant day in Sikh history was heartening. The Baisakhi celebrations were well-organized, with traditional hymns, prayers, and a sense of togetherness that reminded me of the true essence of community and seva.

The langar was served with immense love and humility – simple yet wholesome, just as it should be. I could see volunteers of all ages working selflessly, which added to the sense of unity and devotion.

Overall, the visit to Sri Guru Nanak Darbar on Baisakhi left a lasting impression on me. It’s a place where faith, peace, and community come together beautifully. I highly recommend visiting, especially during such auspicious occasions.
